title: Second Contact
summary: Two Frames deploy, chosen by the players from whatever the repair-day economy left standing. The remaining four kids take ground roles, rotated so nobody repeats a role from Day 1.
deploymentRule: Two Frames deploy, player-chosen from whatever the repair economy left standing.
groundRoleRule: Remaining four kids take ground roles; rotate assignments so nobody repeats a role from Day 1.
designRequirement: Two Frames at two actions each cannot win this fight. Two Frames where at least one reaches Harmonised (65%+) can. The path to that threshold should be discoverable and earned in play — visible, costly, and not simply granted by the GM.
endOfEpisodeEffects: Frames do not level — they remain fixed at 12, advancing only through Resonance bands and unlocks.
